Name: Randomizer - World Routes Loot and Shops
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]Randomizer[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Shuffle where you travel, what you find and what shops offer.[/size]
[size=5][color=#D8B4FE]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/size][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]🗺 World routes[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Shuffle eight supported public interiors and seven Town/Farm outdoor connections. A museum entrance might lead into the saloon; the north exit of your farm might lead to the beach.

[b]Paired returns[/b] let you use the destination's corresponding exit to return to the entrance you used. [b]Routes[/b] records discovered connections without revealing places you have not visited.

[b]Expansion routes[/b] can discover eligible outdoor connections on loaded modded maps. Travel each connection normally in both directions first; two or more qualified connections can then join a seeded shuffle. Scripted, ambiguous, one-way and unsafe routes stay normal.

[b]Unlock building doors[/b] opens supported ordinary homes and shops outside normal hours or friendship requirements. Story, key, festival and custom locks remain protected. Map layouts, buildings and NPC schedules are not rearranged.[/size]

[size=4]A shuffled doorway and its return route.[/size][/center]

[center][img width=960]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55048/55048-1793924490-1106124225.gif[/img]

[size=5][b][color=#98D6B3]🎲 Loot and shops[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Choose independent switches for common monster drops, fishing treasure, mine crates/barrels and seasonal forage. Quest items, recipes and special rewards are excluded from the shuffled pools.

Shop options add up to three purchasable common-item offers, vary those offers' quantities or change eligible ordinary gold prices. [b]Price variation[/b] controls the size of price changes: at 100%, prices can vary by up to 35% either way, subject to a resale floor.

Route discovery records journal entries without giving extra gold or items. There are no added daily luck or loot bonuses.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#A9D9EB]⚙ Start a run[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Open settings with [b]Left Alt + R[/b] during normal gameplay, or use the dice shortcut in your inventory. Randomizer has its own settings menu; [b]SMS and GMCM are optional[/b].

Outdoor routes, Expansion routes and Unlock building doors start on. Public-door, loot and shop randomizers start off. Choose [b]World Shuffle[/b], [b]Loot Lottery[/b], [b]All Systems[/b] or your own switches. Built-in settings save automatically.

Enter an optional [b]Seed code before first loading a save[/b]. A run keeps its original seed and connections. Matching codes and starting route pools produce matching connections; loot also depends on the day, area and event sequence.

Choose [b]Routes[/b] for the journal. The gear beside Close opens menu settings and [b]Get unstuck[/b], which returns you to a clear home arrival or outside the farmhouse. Emergency recovery works with the master switch off, outside events, festivals and active actions.

Console commands: [b]randomizer_settings[/b], [b]randomizer_journal[/b], [b]randomizer_unstuck[/b].[/size]

[center][img width=960]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55048/55048-1793833439-1378135487.gif[/img]
[size=4]Choose which randomizers to enable.[/size][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]Requirements and installation[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.1 or later[/url]. Extract the [b]Randomizer[/b] folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] and launch through SMAPI.

This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested. Randomization pauses in multiplayer.

To uninstall, exit the game and remove the Randomizer folder. Native maps and exits remain available without the mod.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#98D6B3]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Expansion support covers qualifying outdoor routes, not every custom travel rule. Modded interiors, custom shops and modded item pools are not automatically added. Maps can opt out with [b]RandomizerNoShuffle[/b]. Existing groups retain their connections when new routes qualify.

Changed or missing doors and unsafe arrivals fall back to normal travel. World shuffling pauses for festivals and events. Mods that also change the same warps, loot or shops can affect results; compatibility with every mod combination is not guaranteed.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#D8B4FE]Bug Reports & Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Include your game/SMAPI/mod versions, platform, expected and actual result, steps to reproduce, relevant [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] and a useful screenshot or video. For suggestions, explain how the change would help your run.[/size]
